description: Customer managed encryption key (KMS) for cryptographically securing data at rest across AWS services.

sections.title: Key Attributes
sections.description: Usage configuration and automated rotation settings

fields.label: Key Description

default.value: Customer managed key for data encryption

fields.why: Describes key ownership and intended cryptographic scope.
fields.impact: Updates in-place without key material changes.

fields.label: Enable Automatic Annual Key Rotation
fields.why: Automatically generates new cryptographic key material once per year without breaking existing decryptions.
fields.impact: Enforces security compliance best practices without requiring manual re-encryption.

fields.label: Pending Deletion Waiting Period (Days)

validation.error_message: Deletion window must be between 7 and 30 days.

fields.why: Safety delay before AWS permanently purges the key material upon deletion requests.
fields.impact: Data encrypted with a deleted KMS key becomes permanently unrecoverable once deleted.
